use_case: Computer-vision crop yield prediction from drone imagery (weekly block-level estimates for strawberries and watermelons)
data_categories: Drone RGB and multispectral imagery; block boundaries; variety and planting dates; historical block yields (no per-worker data)
affects_individuals: Yes (indirectly: crew hours offered; incidental images of people)
consequential_decision_category: None directly; escalates to Employment if used to set H-2A job order worker counts or cut hours without review, or to Safety/CI if linked to automatic irrigation
human_in_the_loop: Farm Manager checks estimates against hand counts before any crew or sales decision; no hours cut on an estimate alone
applicable_laws: 20 CFR 655.122(i) three-fourths guarantee and 655.122(j)(1) hours-offered records (indirect); FTC Act Section 5 (vendor claims)
status: Approved (conditions due 2026-10-31); strawberries only for 2026-27; watermelons advisory

use_case: FMIS irrigation scheduling recommendations (evapotranspiration and soil moisture model suggests run times)
data_categories: Soil moisture; weather; crop stage; flow history
consequential_decision_category: None today; escalates to Safety/CI if automatic application is enabled
human_in_the_loop: Irrigation Technician approves every recommended schedule; automatic application disabled
applicable_laws: None specific; supplier terms under POL-01 4.6

use_case: General-purpose generative AI chatbots used by office staff to draft letters and buyer emails
data_categories: Risk of worker personal information or buyer prices being pasted
applicable_laws: Fla. Stat. 501.171(2) (reasonable measures if personal information is entered); NIST AI 600-1 used as guidance
status: Not approved for Restricted or Confidential data (POL-04 4.9; POL-05 4.9); approved enterprise tool under evaluation
